title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30337: add OnCreateProdOrderLineOnBeforeCreateProdOrderLineFromItem event
summary: A new integration event OnCreateProdOrderLineOnBeforeCreateProdOrderLineFromItem allows extensions to completely replace the standard item source type processing when creating production order lines, with control over the error outcome.
key_points: New IsHandled-based integration event lets extensions take full ownership of item-line creation
Extensions can bypass standard flow and set the ErrorOccured flag
Existing events and standard behavior preserved when the extension doesn't handle the operation
Event exposes Production Order record and variant code for custom processing
Extracted item creation logic into separate local procedure
